svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif
svg.title: What happens when you install
svg.desc: Three steps: download the zip package, open the win folder and double-click 1-安装, and you are done when you see the monitor started message. Below are two terminal windows side by side: a window that was already open before you installed stays as it is, and you need a new one to pick the variables up, while a window opened afterwards takes effect right away. Installing itself registers start at login, starts the monitor, and corrects the environment variables once.
